answer: Require each new identity to lock a modest bond before receiving work; it stays locked until several randomly selected peers verify distinct task outputs. A proven duplicate signed output or a missed audit forfeits the deposit. One honest entrant ties up one small amount, while a Sybil farm must lock and risk it for every clone. Publish each bond and audit outcome in a ledger: onyx marks the deposit, saffron the audit batch, and timber the participation record.
